Hi Alex —

Sorry we missed you today for the walkthrough. I know schedules get messy; I want to make it easy to pick the path that works best for you and your team. Two quick options: 

1) 15-minute async walkthrough: I’ll record a focused 15-minute screen capture of the trial workspace, call out the integration steps you asked about, and drop the recording + short checklist in Drive. Great if you want fast answers without coordinating calendars.

2) 30-minute live demo: quick, interactive session where we can invite your PM and run a short checklist against your sample dataset. I’ll keep it tight to product + ROI for ops.

If you reply with Option 1 or Option 2 I’ll take care of the rest. If Option 2, here are two slots I can offer:
- Wed 6/21 10:30–11:00 PT
- Thu 6/22 09:00–09:30 PT

Attached: walkthrough_agenda.pdf (one-pager).

Short note on next steps if you pick Option 2: I’ll send a calendar invite with a 20-minute agenda, include a short list of what we’ll need to make the demo immediately actionable.

Thanks — I’m here to make this low lift.

—Sean
